title: Passports for practice squad signings are a logistical challenge for 49ers and Rams

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Passports for practice squad signings are a logistical challenge for 49ers and Rams
sources.description: Every team in the league is in the process of calling players to ask them to join the practice squad, but the Rams and 49ers have another question: "Do you have a passport?"
